query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM document_folders f
                   JOIN document_folders a
                     ON a.id = f.id OR a.id = ANY(f.ancestor_ids)
                   WHERE f.id = $1::text::uuid
                     AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
                     AND a.agent_edit_policy = 'propose'
               ) AS "proposes!"
